requirements.name: Exact cleansing authority and eligible records
requirements.requiredDecision: Define which imposed alignment-alteration source components may actually end, and under what recipient/source eligibility, permission and protection predicates. Preserve willing-only admission; do not import hostile saves, forced Good/Lawful conversion or source-protection bypass.
minimumFields: Named removable source/component classes or an explicit bounded mechanical predicate; exact exclusion/partial-removal behavior for protected, independent and mixed records.

Actual source IDs and terminal operation/callback for lawful removal, distinct from suppression and effective-read masking; no deletion of underlying conduct, development, oath, personality, acquisition or obligation history.

Lock/Anchor snapshot interactions and independently scoped conduct restrictions; lower-source removal alone cannot erase a protected snapshot. No blanket cure permission follows from AC4-ALIGN-01 or AP-AS-01.
requirements.sourceLevelPartsEstablished: Underlying records, effective snapshot ordering and protected components are defined in their own accepted sources. Perfection removal authorization is not.

requirements.name: Useful alignment-dependent benefit map
requirements.requiredDecision: Authorize concrete useful benefits and their exact effects/amounts, eligible recipients, cost/use limits and stacking/arbitration for the selected per-axis model or an explicitly revised complete combination table.
minimumFields: Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic and Good/Neutral/Evil axis entries, with both Neutral labels distinct; explain the resulting defined combinations and interaction of simultaneous benefits.

Explicit partial/fully undefined-input behavior without inventing Neutral or conflating a known Neutral axis with missing data. The old zero-benefit review gate is not a permanent rule denying Neutral recipients all benefits.

Eligibility and information-protection handling for each component. Alignment Immunity can prevent beneficial alignment-dependent components too; no bypass, free benefit, hidden diagnostic or moral hierarchy.
requirements.sourceLevelPartsEstablished: Native benefits based on alignment and applicable protection boundaries are real. No rank9 benefit values or useful effect map is supplied.

requirements.name: Separate benefit lifecycle and accounting
requirements.requiredDecision: Keep the selected instantaneous completed cleansing operation distinct from its separately bounded benefit source; expressly define that source rather than deriving duration or permanence from the native Instantaneous field.
minimumFields: Live versus snapshot alignment inputs; source/admission time, exact duration/deadline and concentration policy, if any; no comparator duration imported.
Benefit reevaluation on legitimate alignment changes and active Lock/Anchor/protection, suppression/resumption, independent ending, replacement/recast and exact overlap arbitration.

Spent resources/uses, surviving source clocks, actual damage/custody/history remain current: no refill, duplicated entitlements, missed-event catch-up or revival of ended sources. Completed lawful cleansing is not reversed when a benefit suppresses or expires.
requirements.sourceLevelPartsEstablished: Separating completed removal from a continuing benefit is already the selected direction. Exact benefit clock and operative transitions remain undefined.

minimumIntegratedWitness.minimumNextAction: One expressly authorized Perfection-only contract containing W01-W03, followed by the useful paid positive/adverse encounter evidence. No unchanged replay or full five-identity packet is needed.
requiredPositiveEvidence: A legally acquired/prepared native rank9 cast on an actually willing eligible recipient, with exact Action/V,S,F/range and finalRP/Dissonance/Refrain/counter history; show a permitted imposed alteration ending and a concrete useful benefit being used.

A separate useful benefit encounter across another supported alignment category, with meaningful Neutral/undefined, refusal/protection, overlap, suppression and ending/recast branches. Resolve actual old/new effect states, original deadlines and resource usage while retaining oath and underlying conduct history.
stateRequirements: Complete source-qualified actors and acquisition histories; exact recipient axes and imposed source lineage; preserved underlying history and protected snapshots; live paid resources/actions/uses; benefit source identity/clock; intermediate/final state and forward/inverse operations.
minimumIntegratedWitness.provenance: Synthetic conditional review operands may be used only when explicitly authorized and labelled. They are not campaign events, observed play or user-authored events by inference.
minimumIntegratedWitness.authorshipVersusExternalFacts: W01-W03 are unresolved spell-local design/permission decisions that can be supplied by an expressly authorized scoped Director contract. They are not a demand for a newly invented deity, campaign or external lore record. Any real actor/source/permission fact used in a witness still requires its own binding.

absenceScope: Missing in this exact current source set; not a finding that these mechanics cannot be authored.
wholeSpellGateReason: The missing cleansing operation and useful benefits are the native positive promise itself, not optional external edge cases.
